levelList.name: With Each Smite, I Sever Thine Advent!
levelList.desc:
This Skill counts as an Attack Skill even when it activates instead of a Defense Skill; this Skill is unaffected by Defense Power-changing effects, and is instead affected by Attack Power-changing effects
[StartBattle] Apply 2 [AttackUp] and 2 [DefenseUp] on all "Le Noir" allied Identities (once per turn)
[WhenUse] At 6+ total sum of ([Vibration] Potency + [NoirNailDonQuixote]) on all targets, Coin Power +1
[WhenUse] At 3+ [ChargeNoirAlly] Potency, Coin Power +1
[WhenUse] Deal +30% damage for every excess Atk Weight beyond the # of actual targets (for Focused Encounters, Parts)
[BeforeAttack] The final Coin gains Final Power +2 for every highest Reson. (max 8)
[EndSkill] Consume all [NoirShieldUpDonQuixote]

coindescs.desc: [OnSucceedAttack] Trigger [VibrationExplosion]; then, reduce target's [Vibration] Count by 1

[OnSucceedAttack] Apply the following effects on target depending on its respective [NoirNailDonQuixote] Stack
- If target has 3+ [NoirNailDonQuixote], trigger [VibrationExplosion]; then, reduce target's [Vibration] Count by 1
- Deal Sloth damage equal to ([NoirNailDonQuixote] on target x 1.5)% of this Coin's final damage (max 45%)
- Consume all [NoirNailDonQuixote] on target
